source.description:
## PROBLEM
PR #280 CI run 33726208807 intermittently failed tests/unit/cli/stop.test.ts orphan-reaper assertion because the test mocks process.kill but not process-liveness /proc reads. A real host PID 1234 with a different start time correctly triggers the production PID-reuse guard, making synthetic stdout empty. Muse debugger unitAI-53ieb reproduced 15/15 isolated passes and full 2172/22, classifying this as host-state-dependent test isolation.

## SUCCESS
The test deterministically controls liveness/start-time behavior and proves both terminal-alive reap and PID-reuse/dead paths without reading host /proc state. Production control.ts and process-liveness.ts behavior remains unchanged unless an independent product bug is proven.

## SCOPE
tests/unit/cli/stop.test.ts and minimal test-only mocks/helpers. Relates to closed origin unitAI-yme9q. Evidence: /home/dawid/.cache/xtrm-validation/unitAI-jndsb.15/ci-33726208807/stop-flake-classification.txt.

## NON_GOALS
No release branch fix, no skip/quarantine/retry masking, no weaker assertions, no production behavior change, no publication.

## VALIDATION
Run affected file repeatedly, full supported suite alone, and demonstrate independence from whether host PID 1234 exists. Reviewer confirms production PID-reuse guard remains tested.
